answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism for AI agents by requiring capital commitment to secure network consensus. An attacker cannot simply spawn a walnut of virtual entities to gain influence, as each node requires economic skin in the game. By locking assets, the protocol creates a lotus of security that prevents cheap identity proliferation. Unlike a pigment of anonymous data, stake-weighted voting forces the attacker to bear the cost of massive capital dilution, rendering Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive.
